newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus spring sowing over, 1.46 mln hectares sown.
newsitem.headline: Belarus spring sowing over, 1.46 mln hectares sown.

text.p: Belarus has completed its spring sowing campaign with 1.456 million hectares planted to early spring grains against 1.434 million hectares the previous year, Agriculture Minister Ivan Shakolo said on Thursday.
Re-sowing of 2-3,000 hectares would have to take place in two southern regions due to frosts at a cost of 10 billion Belarussian roubles, Shakolo told a news conference.
Forecasts of a 6.5-million-tonne grain crop from 5.9 million tonnes last year were realistic, though Belarus was having problems with supplies of nitrous fertilisers.
"We have 243,000 tonnes of nitrous fertiliser from 182,000 last year, but to fulfil the programme this year we need at least another 100,000 tonnes. This problem has not been solved yet," he said.
